soundscape: A low room hum fills the cramped garage, threaded with the metallic tick of a cooling engine, the small clink of tools on metal, and the soft drag of a rag over greasy hands.

claims.text: Two mechanics argue over an engine in a cramped garage.
A single hanging work lamp lights the garage, with oil-dark tools, shelving, hanging belts, and scuffed concrete around the engine bay.
The older mechanic wears grease-stained work clothes with sleeves pushed up, while the younger mechanic wipes greasy hands on a rag.
The engine is partly stripped with an exposed belt, and a wrench rests on the fender.

The older man’s sleeves are pushed to the elbow, his forearms smeared with grease; he sets a wrench down on the metal with deliberate care and fixes the other man with a flat, tired stare, then speaks his verdict. The engine ticks softly as it cools, and the narrow space feels close, crowded by shelving, hanging belts, and the smell of oil.
